args.prompt: [Look: Late-1970s cold-war border thriller, live action, 35mm, muted steel-blue winter colour.] [Setting: an ice-choked river landing at dusk, timber cable ferry, ferry hut with stove smoke.] [Cast: VERA KOST (patched army greatcoat, rifle on her back); PAVEL KOST (torn deserter tunic, bandaged hand).] Single shot: wide static camera, 32mm, low on the landing, one continuous 10 s take. Everyone looks at each other and the props in front of them, never into the lens. At 1 s, PAVEL stumbles out of the birches onto the planks. At 4 s, VERA swings her rifle toward him, then lowers it. At 7 s, VERA KOST speaks [hard, low: "Get on the boat. Don't talk."]. Motion carries on through the last half second. [Adults only, no kids. Invented characters; a named real person becomes only their moves and attitude, never their likeness. No gore; bloodstains on clothing are fine, no blood draining out. Nobody looks into the camera.]
